# Welcoming Luke Morgan to Infinite


We are excited to announce that Luke Morgan has joined Infinite as our Founding Business Operations Lead, helping to lead our platform growth operations.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


April 6, 2026


·


1 min read


Team


We are thrilled to welcome Luke Morgan as our Founding Business Operations Lead, helping drive platform growth operations at Infinite.


Luke brings over a decade of fintech and payments expertise, with a track record of scaling merchant operations across leading platforms including Sardine and Canopy, plus seven years on Wall Street at Brown Brothers Harriman.


Most recently, he built and scaled an in-house fintech product from the ground up, onboarding hundreds of merchants and accelerating payment operations across a major national enterprise.


At Infinite, our platform is embedded infrastructure within our customers' product experiences – Luke's operational depth reinforces our ability to accelerate our mission to build the best stablecoin merchant experience for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Luke!
